post.summary: Add unsigned WBS Payable exception-evidence retain to the fixed Stage 1 reader
post.description: OIDC actor and configured tenant/entity are server-derived. PostgreSQL accepts only version 2 with exactly the six Stage 1 evidence-read permissions and adds only WBS.PAYABLE.OPERATOR_ATTEST. This grants no import, review, Draft, approval, posting, ledger, or WBS write authority.

post.summary: Enable the fixed TEST_ONLY WBS, Bank, Journal and report workflow on the staging test entity
post.description: Available only when the fixed staging WBS test-import mode is enabled. The authenticated OIDC actor and configured tenant/entity are server-derived. PostgreSQL accepts only version 3 with exactly the Stage 1 WBS operator permissions and replaces it with the closed controlled-test permission bundle at version 4. No identity, permission or scope selector is accepted in the body.

get.summary: Observe a bounded unsigned production WBS read
get.description: Requires WBS.AUTOREC.VIEW. This disabled-by-default pilot returns NOT_ADMITTED observations only; it never persists data, writes WBS, creates transactions or allocations, dispatches work, creates a Draft, approves, or posts.

post.summary: Propose exact server-derived Insurance PC evidence for independent Controller approval
post.description: Requires WBS.INSURANCE.PC_MAPPING.PROPOSE. The caller supplies only an immutable pre-admission or controlled-live observation id/hash and reason; PC codes, company codes, raw rows, captured times, tokens and aggregate arrays are forbidden. This command does not admit evidence or enable accounting actions.

get.summary: Read one immutable Insurance PC mapping proposal and hash trace

post.summary: Approve exact first-package Insurance PC mappings after SoD and CAS
post.description: Requires WBS.INSURANCE.PC_MAPPING.APPROVE, strong revision CAS, actor-bound idempotency, independent Controller SoD, exact observation/proposal/catalog hashes and a catalog effective interval covering the entire mapping range. Approval is mapping-only and does not admit provider artifacts.

get.summary: Read one effective Controller-approved PC/company mapping trace
get.description: Requires WBS.INSURANCE.PC_MAPPING.VIEW. Returns only scoped ids, effective dates, match count and observation/proposal/decision/catalog hashes; provider raw rows and transport artifacts are never returned.

get.summary: Read bounded immutable WBS company catalog candidates
get.description: Requires WBS.COMPANY.CATALOG.VIEW. Returns retained source hashes, controls, and validation counts for the authenticated entity only. It grants no accounting mapping or posting authority.

post.summary: Retain one immutable company catalog candidate
post.description: Requires WBS.COMPANY.CATALOG.RETAIN. Retains only allowlisted source metadata, exact hashes, row controls, account-book controls, company rows, and ERROR/REVIEW/INFO findings. Credential-like fields fail closed. This does not approve a company, change an entity binding, or create mapping_snapshot.

get.summary: Read bounded candidate companies, validation findings, and current Controller decisions

post.summary: Classify a retained company candidate without approving it
post.description: Requires WBS.COMPANY.CATALOG.CLASSIFY, strong revision CAS, idempotency, and a Controller distinct from the catalog retainer. Appends audit/outbox evidence and creates no entity binding or mapping_snapshot.

post.summary: Approve one exact Controller-classified company and atomically bind the entity
post.description: Requires WBS.COMPANY.CATALOG.APPROVE, strong revision CAS, exact catalog and row hashes, reconciled account-book controls, exact entity currency/effective scope, and an approver distinct from both retainer and classifier. Atomically writes or verifies the entity WBS company binding. It never creates mapping_snapshot.

post.summary: Record an immutable WBS read-only snapshot observation
post.description: This creates evidence in REFS only. It never writes WBS, source documents, journal entries or ledger lines. Production snapshots require a verified detached Ed25519 signature from a pinned IT key.

post.summary: Persist an admitted signed WBS Payable snapshot as review evidence
post.description: Accepts exactly one production V2 Payable snapshot whose detached Ed25519 signature, company, currency and snapshot-token scope pass the configured pinned-key verifier. Persists immutable snapshot receipt plus Raw, Normalized and Staging or Exception evidence only. It never writes WBS, creates or approves a Draft, or posts.

post.summary: Verify and atomically persist one provider-signed WBS Payable delivery
post.description: Service-only OIDC command. The service derives tenant and entity from authenticated context and uses only server-pinned provider trust. It verifies issuer, kid, Ed25519 signatures, raw request/response/package hashes, exact company scope, nonce and 15-minute TTL before one serializable transaction persists the append-only delivery receipt, immutable snapshot receipts, and Raw/Normalized/Staging or Exception rows. It never creates, approves, or posts a Journal.

post.summary: Retain one provider-signed Final-1 Payables delivery as immutable authoritative evidence
post.description: Service-only OIDC command. Verifies current receipt TTL, pinned Ed25519 signatures, exact raw hashes, credential redaction, Controller-approved entity/company/USD scope, then stores the exact four artifacts under S3 Object Lock and atomically retains source documents and review exceptions. It never writes WBS or creates a Draft, review, approval, Journal, ledger line, or posting.

post.summary: Retain one provider-signed Final-1 Insurance delivery as immutable authoritative evidence
post.description: Service-only OIDC command. Exact signed 12-month coverage becomes immutable amortization coverage evidence; missing, invalid, or approximate coverage becomes PREPAID_COVERAGE_REQUIRED retained findings. All source rows remain PENDING_REVIEW or QUARANTINED. It never writes WBS or creates a Draft, review, approval, Journal, ledger line, or posting.

post.summary: Retain one provider-signed Final-1 Bank delivery as immutable evidence
post.description: Service-only OIDC command. Requires the exact list_bank_transactions tool, pinned Ed25519 receipt and package signatures, four Object-Lock artifact versions with CLEAN scans, and Provider-signed row count/per-currency MONEY4 controls that REFS recomputes. Rows remain PENDING_REVIEW with no matching, Draft, review, approval, or posting authority.

post.summary: Retain provider-signed Cost control evidence without creating a CWIP transaction
post.description: Service-only OIDC evidence command for exact list_control_totals/COST_GENERAL_LEDGER rows. Signed controls are recomputed and retained; the current Provider contract does not make this report a transaction producer, so every row is CONTROL_EVIDENCE_ONLY and cannot create a transaction, CWIP Draft, review, approval, Journal, or posting.

post.summary: Retain provider-signed Property comparison control evidence
post.description: Service-only OIDC evidence command for exact list_control_totals/PROPERTY_COMPARISON scope. It preserves property, bank-account and period controls under Object Lock. It does not misrepresent control totals as a Property Operations rent transaction and grants no accounting authority.

get.summary: Read exact Object-Lock evidence for one formally admitted WBS source document
get.description: Requires GL.JE.VIEW for the authenticated tenant and path entity. Returns a closed projection derived only from the append-only Final-1 admission, exact retained source row, and matching source document. Receipt, request, response, and package hashes and Object Lock VersionIds come from persisted server admission evidence. Legacy signed snapshots, unsigned GET-only Pilot data, unresolved periods, caller claims, raw bytes, storage locations, signatures, credentials, and arbitrary external references fail closed or are never returned.

post.summary: Admit the exact retained Insurance observation after independent Controller approval
post.description: Provider-service-only Phase B command. It accepts no raw artifacts or storage coordinates. The server rereads the durable Phase A observation, exact original Object Lock VersionIds and hashes, rescans all four objects, re-verifies the Ed25519 package, and requires the exact current non-revoked Controller approval before formal admission. It never rewrites the retained objects and does not require the Provider service principal to hold Controller VIEW permission.

get.summary: List retained operator-attested WBS Payable exception evidence
get.description: Requires WBS.PAYABLE.OPERATOR_ATTEST. Unsigned exception evidence only: every row is OPERATOR_ATTESTED, signature_verified=false, EXCEPTION_REVIEW_REQUIRED, cannot create a Draft, and is not Posted. The response excludes provider rows, raw payloads, hashes, credentials, and accounting action authority.

post.summary: Freeze a fresh server-reread WBS Payable page as unsigned exception evidence
post.description: Requires WBS.PAYABLE.OPERATOR_ATTEST. The server rereads list_payables and requires exact observation/content hashes from the prior GET-only view. It stores append-only OPERATOR_ATTESTED evidence with signature_verified=false and EXCEPTION_REVIEW_REQUIRED, including unassigned or mixed-company observations. Company assignment is not inferred. It never creates Raw/Source/Staging, a Bill, Draft, Journal, ledger line, approval, or posting.

get.summary: List real retained WBS Payable exception rows
get.description: Requires WBS.PAYABLE.OPERATOR_ATTEST. Returns closed display facts and server-derived signed-link readiness for immutable OPERATOR_ATTESTED rows. A later signed link points to the separate signed review queue; this response never promotes the retained row or grants Review, Draft, approval, Post, GL, or report authority.

get.summary: List persisted read-only AI findings for retained WBS exception evidence
get.description: Requires WBS.PAYABLE.OPERATOR_ATTEST. Returns only immutable, hash-traceable AI findings materialized from retained WBS exception evidence. It excludes raw provider payloads and credentials, and cannot create a Draft, review, approve, post, or write WBS.

get.summary: List persisted read-only AI findings for missing prepaid coverage evidence
get.description: Requires AI.AMORTIZATION.PROPOSE. Returns immutable, hash-traceable findings where a prepaid source lacks retained whole-month coverage evidence and cannot create a Draft, review, approve, post, or write a source system.

get.summary: List immutable exact duplicate Payable findings
get.description: Returns retained exact duplicate payable evidence and cannot change either source, create a Draft, review, approve, or post.

get.summary: List immutable unmatched bank payment findings
get.description: Returns retained bank evidence and cannot alter a bank line, create a Draft, review, approve, or post.

get.summary: List immutable cost dimension findings
get.description: Returns retained source evidence and never infer dimensions or create a Draft, review, approve, or post.

get.summary: List immutable loan reference findings
get.description: Returns retained source evidence and never infer a loan or create a Draft, review, approve, or post.

post.summary: Assign a human owner and due date to one immutable AI finding
post.description: Requires AI.FINDING.ASSIGN, an Idempotency-Key, and a strong If-Match revision. It verifies the exact retained finding hash, appends audit/outbox evidence, and changes only human accountability. It cannot modify the source, create a Draft, review, approve, post, or write WBS.

get.summary: List immutable AI finding hashes available for controller assignment
get.description: Requires AI.FINDING.ASSIGN. Returns only retained finding identity, hash, reason, suggested action, and false accounting-action flags. It cannot resolve a finding, change a source, create a Draft, review, approve, post, or write WBS.

get.summary: List retained controller accountability actions for immutable AI findings
get.description: Requires AI.FINDING.ASSIGN. Returns owner, due date, revision, audit actor and exact finding hash only. It cannot resolve a finding, change a source, create a Draft, review, approve, post, or write WBS.

post.summary: Retain a human resolution receipt for one immutable AI finding action
post.description: Requires AI.FINDING.RESOLVE, an Idempotency-Key, and a strong If-Match revision. It records a human conclusion against an assigned finding without changing source evidence or creating a Draft, review, approval, posting, or WBS write.

get.summary: Read retained no-action accounting analysis summary
get.description: Returns retained analysis only and cannot create a Draft, review, approve, or post.

get.summary: Read the server-published AI accounting capability boundary
get.description: Returns implemented and planned AI skills only; it cannot create a Draft, review, approve, or post.

get.summary: Read retained no-action controller analysis reports
get.description: Returns completed durable controller-memo receipts only; it cannot create a Draft, review, approve, or post.

get.summary: Read deterministic recurring-obligation accrual candidates
get.description: Requires AI.ANALYSIS.EXPLAIN and authoritative retained WBS payable evidence. It returns review-required candidates only; it cannot create a Draft, review, approve, post, or write WBS.

get.summary: Classify formally admitted invoice evidence
get.description: Reads provider-signed retained payable evidence for one accounting period and returns source-bound expense, prepaid, accrual, capitalization-review, or blocked classifications. This read cannot create a Draft, review, approve, post, read raw artifacts, or invoke a model.

post.summary: Persist a source-bound deterministic invoice accounting classification run
post.description: Requires AI.ANALYSIS.EXPLAIN and an Idempotency-Key. The server recomputes classifications from exact retained provider evidence and atomically appends immutable classification evidence, audit, outbox, and receipt rows. It cannot create a Draft, review, approve, post, read raw artifacts, or invoke a model.

get.summary: List retained invoice accrual classification evidence
get.description: Requires AI analysis read authority. Returns only closed, source-bound ACCRUAL_REVIEW evidence. This no-store read exposes no raw provider bytes and grants no Draft, review, approval, or posting authority.

get.summary: List immutable invoice accrual proposals
get.description: Requires AI.ACCRUAL.VIEW. This no-store evidence read cannot create a journal action.

post.summary: Retain a source-bound invoice accrual proposal
post.description: Requires AI.ACCRUAL.PROPOSE and Idempotency-Key. It atomically writes proposal evidence, audit, and outbox only; it cannot create, review, approve, or post a journal entry.

get.summary: List retained policy-bound capitalization evidence
List immutable invoice capitalization proposals

post.summary: Retain a policy-bound capitalization proposal
post.description: Writes proposal, audit, and outbox only; never a Draft or posted journal.

post.summary: Create a retained controller explanation without accounting authority
post.description: Requires an idempotency key and creates a redacted explanation receipt only; it cannot create a Draft, review, approve, or post.

get.summary: List retained source-bound amortization coverage evidence
get.description: Requires AI.AMORTIZATION.VIEW. This no-store read returns immutable evidence only and cannot create a Draft JE, review, approve, post, or write a source system.

post.summary: Retain source-bound whole-month coverage evidence for AI amortization analysis
post.description: Requires AI.AMORTIZATION.PROPOSE and an Idempotency-Key. This command retains immutable coverage evidence only; it cannot create a Draft JE, review, approve, post, or write a source system.

post.summary: Persist an evidence-backed AI prepaid amortization proposal
post.description: Requires AI.AMORTIZATION.PROPOSE and an Idempotency-Key. This command creates immutable PROPOSED analysis evidence only; it cannot create a Draft JE, review, approve, post, or write a source system.

get.summary: List immutable AI amortization schedule proposals
get.description: Requires AI.AMORTIZATION.VIEW. Each closed schedule line includes its immutable identifier and exact source-bound verified-clean attachment IDs so a separately authorized human maker can select exactly one line; this read creates no Draft or later journal action.

post.summary: Create a human-controlled Draft JE from one immutable AI amortization line
post.description: Requires AI.AMORTIZATION.DRAFT, GL.JE.CREATE, exact proposal evidence, and source-bound clean attachments. The AI proposer cannot create this Draft; the resulting standard MANUAL Draft must use the normal submit, review, approve, and post workflow.

post.summary: Run the isolated staging-only AI amortization accounting workflow
post.description: STAGING TEST ONLY. Requires the server-side fixed caller and AI.TEST.WORKFLOW source-maker grant. Derives an UNSIGNED_TEST_ONLY source from an already posted WBS test payable and uses seven distinct static test actors for proposal, MANUAL Draft, Submit, Review, Approve, and Post. Completed stages persist through their production idempotency receipts. A PARTIAL result names the last durable stage and is resumed by retrying the exact request with the same Idempotency-Key. It does not change or bypass any formal AI endpoint permission.

201.description: Controlled-test workflow posted or durable PARTIAL receipt resumable with the same Idempotency-Key

get.summary: List immutable AI payable proposals for human review
get.description: Requires AP.BILL.CREATE. Each proposal is derived only from immutable reviewed WBS Payable evidence and approved mapping output. This read is no-store and does not create a Draft, submit, approve, or post a journal.

post.summary: Record an immutable human accept or reject decision for an AI payable proposal
post.description: Requires AP.BILL.CREATE, an idempotency key, and a strong revision. The result never creates a Draft or advances a journal; the ordinary separately authorized WBS Payable Draft workflow remains required.

get.summary: List admitted Property Rent pickup readiness
get.description: Authenticated entity-and-period-scoped GET only. Returns immutable signed admission, review, Draft and Posted lineage with MONEY4 strings, exact mapping snapshot version/hash, audit times, and server-derived capabilities. Reviewed rows from any other period are excluded. It accepts no command headers, body, browser token, provider secret, or WBS credential.

post.summary: Independently review one signed Property Rent admission
post.description: Requires WBS.PROPERTY.RENT.REVIEW, Idempotency-Key and strong If-Match equal to the staging revision returned by the queue. The server resolves the approved setting and unique highest-priority mapping; it creates review evidence only and never creates or posts a Journal.

post.summary: Create an AR Invoice and AUTO Draft from reviewed Property Rent evidence
post.description: Requires WBS.PROPERTY.RENT.DRAFT, AR.INVOICE.CREATE, GL.JE.AUTO.CREATE, Idempotency-Key and strong If-Match equal to the staging revision returned by the queue. Creates a balanced MONEY4 Draft and exact SOURCE_TO_JE lineage only; standard Submit, Review, Approve and Post remain separate.

get.summary: Read signed Insurance amortization readiness and retained evidence
get.description: Authenticated entity-period GET only. Requires GL.REPORT.VIEW and returns exact signed admission, source version and hashes, approved configuration, POSTED capitalization, independent review, monthly AUTO Draft and Journal status using MONEY4 strings. AI proposals remain PROPOSED evidence and never imply review or posting authority.

post.summary: Independently review one signed Insurance monthly schedule line
post.description: Requires PREPAID.AMORTIZATION.REVIEW, Idempotency-Key, a strong If-Match equal to the exact source version, and exact source/proposal/coverage hashes. Retains immutable review evidence only; it creates no Draft, approval, posting, or ledger line.

post.summary: Create one monthly AUTO Draft from independently reviewed Insurance evidence
post.description: Requires PREPAID.AMORTIZATION.DRAFT, GL.JE.AUTO.CREATE, Idempotency-Key, strong If-Match revision zero and the immutable review evidence hash. Creates a balanced MONEY4 AUTO Draft with signed-root and derived-source lineage only. Standard Submit, Review, Approve and Post remain separate and there is no automatic posting.

get.summary: List reviewed WBS Payable evidence and current AP Draft readiness
get.description: Requires both WBS.AUTOREC.VIEW and AP.VIEW. Returns only closed retained 094 review facts plus server-revalidated readiness. It exposes no raw provider payload, credential, signature, or command authority.

get.summary: List admitted WBS Payables and server-derived review readiness
get.description: Requires both WBS.PAYABLE.REVIEW and AP.VIEW. Returns only signed, admitted production Payables and closed local review facts. Unsigned pilot rows, raw provider payload, credentials, signatures and action authority are excluded. This GET creates no Draft.

get.summary: Read one admitted WBS Payable review candidate
get.description: Requires both WBS.PAYABLE.REVIEW and AP.VIEW. Re-derives the exact review inputs and readiness from retained signed evidence and local controls. This GET performs no review and creates no Draft.

get.summary: Read one reviewed WBS Payable evidence record
get.description: Requires both WBS.AUTOREC.VIEW and AP.VIEW. Returns one exact retained review and current server readiness; this GET cannot create a Draft or perform an accounting transition.

post.summary: Review one immutable admitted WBS Payable into standard staging evidence
post.description: Requires WBS.PAYABLE.REVIEW and an exact immutable production Payable row, approved setting and unique approved WBS_PAYABLE_AP mapping, active local vendor and accounts, OPEN period, and verified-clean attachments. The reviewer must be distinct from ingestion and configuration actors. This materializes Raw, Source, Rule and READY_FOR_DRAFT staging evidence only; it never creates a Bill, Journal Entry, approval, posting batch, or ledger line.

post.summary: Bind one verified-clean attachment version to one admitted WBS Payable row
post.description: Requires WBS.PAYABLE.REVIEW and AP.VIEW. Freezes the exact tenant, entity, inbound row, source version, inbound and provider receipt hashes, evidence hash, attachment content hash, and storage version. The binder must differ from the snapshot importer, uploader, and scanner. This evidence-only command cannot Review, create Raw/Source/Staging, create a Bill or Journal, or write a ledger.

post.summary: Reserve an upload for one exact admitted WBS Payable
post.description: Requires ATTACHMENT.CREATE and AP.VIEW. The server freezes a row-specific upload intent backed by the admitted signed production receipt. It never lists entity-wide attachments and cannot Bind, Review, create a Draft, Journal, or posting.

get.summary: Read attachment status for one exact admitted WBS Payable
get.description: Requires AP.VIEW and either ATTACHMENT.CREATE or WBS.PAYABLE.REVIEW. Returns only row-bound display metadata and server-derived capabilities; never hashes, storage versions, provider receipts, object URLs, or entity-wide attachments.

post.summary: Bind a row-reserved verified-clean attachment without exposing CAS facts
post.description: Requires WBS.PAYABLE.REVIEW and AP.VIEW. The browser submits only attachment ID and reason; the server re-derives exact source, receipt, provider receipt, evidence, content and storage-version CAS. Binder remains distinct from importer, uploader and scanner. The command cannot Review, create a Draft, Journal, or posting.

post.summary: Create one source-linked AP Bill and AUTO Journal Draft from reviewed WBS Payable evidence
post.description: Requires AP.BILL.CREATE and exact immutable 094 review evidence. The authenticated maker must differ from the reviewer. All Bill, journal, mapping and attachment facts are server-derived from the frozen review. This atomically creates an AP Bill Draft, balanced AUTO Journal Draft, SOURCE_TO_JE and JE_ATTACHMENT lineage only; it never submits, reviews, approves, posts, or writes a ledger line.

post.summary: Review one signed Cost-to-CWIP record into controlled staging evidence
post.description: Requires WBS.COST.CWIP.REVIEW and one exact signed production Cost record, approved setting and mapping, active accounts, and an open period. The reviewer must be independent of source admission and configuration. This creates immutable source and staging evidence only; it never creates a Draft, approval, posting batch, or ledger line.

post.summary: Create one source-linked AUTO Journal Draft from reviewed Cost-to-CWIP evidence
post.description: Requires WBS.COST.CWIP.DRAFT and GL.JE.AUTO.CREATE. The maker must be different from the reviewer. Journal lines, source link, period, mapping and amounts are re-derived from immutable reviewed evidence. This creates only an unsubmitted balanced AUTO Draft; it never approves, posts, or writes a ledger line.

post.summary: Admit one signed WBS bank statement without starting reconciliation
post.description: Accepts one closed WBS_SIGNED_BANK_ADMISSION_V1 manifest. The authenticated tenant and path entity are authoritative; the database requires WBS.BANK.ADMIT and an exact previously admitted production snapshot. It creates immutable statement/source evidence only and never matches, reconciles, creates a Draft, or posts.

admission.description: Exact signed WBS_SIGNED_BANK_ADMISSION_V1 manifest; validated fail-closed by the runtime.

get.summary: List authoritative Journal Entries for the authenticated entity
Read the current authenticated actor's fixed Journal workflow capabilities
get.description: Requires OIDC and GL.JE.VIEW for the path entity. The server checks only the fixed GL.JE.SUBMIT, GL.JE.REVIEW, GL.JE.APPROVE, and GL.JE.POST permissions; callers cannot submit a permission name. These booleans are presentation hints only. Every command independently revalidates permission, entity scope, segregation of duties, idempotency, and optimistic concurrency.

get.summary: Read exact Journal Entry line evidence for one accounting period
get.description: Requires OIDC GL.JE.VIEW for the path entity and an exact entity-scoped periodId. Returns retained Journal Lines in line order. A ledger_line_id is present only for an actual POSTED ledger row; Draft and other unposted entries return null. This GET cannot create, transition, approve, post, reverse, import, or otherwise mutate a Journal Entry.

get.summary: List immutable source-document evidence for the authenticated entity
get.description: Requires the configured OIDC Bearer token and GL.JE.VIEW for the path entity. Returns persisted REFS metadata and immutable identifiers only; it never returns raw provider payloads, attachment bytes, storage references, or provider credentials. This entity-scoped endpoint does not accept a period query parameter; each row carries its persisted business and accounting dates.

get.summary: List bounded POSTED WBS TEST_ONLY payable sources for the controlled staging AI workflow
get.description: STAGING TEST ONLY. Requires the configured OIDC Bearer token and GL.JE.VIEW for the path entity. Returns at most 100 persisted WBS payable source records inside the exact configured OPEN period. The fixed filters require source_system to equal the exact active entity binding (WBS or REFS_STAGE1), source_module payable, document_type WBS_TEST_PAYABLE, status POSTED, and at least one exact source-linked POSTED journal entry. It never returns raw provider payloads, attachment bytes, storage references, or provider credentials.

get.summary: Read one immutable source-document evidence record for the authenticated entity
get.description: Requires the configured OIDC Bearer token and GL.JE.VIEW for the path entity. The source document must belong to that entity. Returns persisted REFS metadata and line evidence only; it never returns raw provider payloads, attachment bytes, storage references, or provider credentials. This endpoint does not accept a period query parameter; its immutable business and accounting dates are response evidence.

get.summary: List authoritative read-only bank transaction evidence
get.description: Returns only authenticated tenant/entity/account-scoped bank source and latest match evidence. This operation cannot match, clear, sign off, or post.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based offset within the exact authenticated account and date scope.

post.summary: Match a bank transaction to exact POSTED payment evidence
post.description: Creates one audited active match between the bank transaction and an authoritative POSTED AP payment or AR receipt after exact entity, account, direction, currency, amount, date, source, revision, and ledger-line checks. This command does not create, modify, approve, or post a journal entry.

post.summary: Unmatch an active bank-payment evidence link
post.description: Ends exactly one ACTIVE bank match after authenticated scope, match revision, idempotency, bank-source identity, and review-reason checks. Immutable Journal Entry, ledger, source-link, audit, and prior match evidence are retained. This command does not reverse, modify, approve, or post a journal entry.

get.summary: Read an authoritative reconciliation statement evidence summary
get.description: Returns only the live DRAFT, IN_REVIEW, or REOPENED reconciliation worksheet for the exact account and statement ending date. Activity starts after the latest prior RECONCILED statement; historical RECONCILED rows are not dynamically recomputed or returned. This read cannot match, clear, reopen, sign off, or post.

get.summary: Discover retained reconciliation account and cutoff scopes
get.description: Requires BANK.VIEW. Returns existing DRAFT, IN_REVIEW, REOPENED, and RECONCILED statement keys for the authenticated entity so a reader can select an exact account and cutoff. This read cannot start, clear, review, sign off, reopen, create a Journal Entry, or post.

get.summary: Read the entity-scoped Chart of Accounts and period balances
get.description: Returns account-master facts and per-currency POSTED-ledger balances for one authorised entity and accounting period. A balance is never converted or combined across currencies. This operation cannot create, edit, import, export, connect a bank, or post.

get.summary: Read the authenticated entity display name and accounting-period boundary
get.description: Returns the persisted REFS entity name, code, base currency, and one exact accounting-period boundary for the path entity. It cannot create, edit, import, approve, post, or call a provider.

get.summary: Read the current authenticated actor's effective entity permissions
get.description: Returns only the current session actor identifier, tenant and entity scope, current configured grant-set revision, effective permission codes embedded in this authenticated database context, current configured permission codes, and whether the session must be refreshed. It accepts no actor identifier and cannot grant, revoke, create, edit, approve, or post.

get.summary: Read the entity-scoped account register from POSTED ledger evidence
get.description: Returns one account's period entries and currency-separated opening and running balances from POSTED ledger lines only. Every row carries immutable Journal, Journal Line, Ledger Line, and retained source identifiers. This operation cannot create, edit, clear, reconcile, export, or post.

get.summary: Read paginated entity-and-period scoped POSTED General Ledger evidence
get.description: Returns only POSTED ledger lines, fixed four-decimal debit and credit strings, and immutable Journal Entry, Journal Line, Ledger Line, and retained Source Document identifiers. Query and pagination are read-only presentation controls. This operation cannot create, edit, post, adjust, reconcile, export, or call a provider.

get.summary: Read authoritative financial statements from POSTED ledger evidence
get.description: Returns entity-and-period-scoped Trial Balance, Balance Sheet, Income Statement, and direct cash movement rows. Account classification is explicit and every row carries immutable journal, ledger, and source drill identifiers. This operation cannot create, adjust, post, export, or persist a report.

get.summary: Read the latest approved immutable financial statement snapshot
get.description: Returns the latest approved immutable entity-and-period-scoped frozen statement version with its ledger evidence hash and per-row journal, ledger, and source drill identifiers. This operation cannot create, adjust, post, approve, or persist a report.

get.summary: Read a conservative current-to-prior financial statement comparison
get.description: Reads POSTED financial-statement evidence for two distinct, non-overlapping entity-scoped accounting periods. Missing evidence on either side is explicitly marked and cannot be interpreted as zero. This operation cannot create, adjust, post, export, or persist a report.

post.summary: Prepare a frozen statement snapshot from POSTED ledger evidence
post.description: Requires the report-snapshot preparer permission and report-view permission. Creates only an immutable pending proposal; it cannot approve itself or alter the ledger.

post.summary: Independently approve a prepared immutable statement snapshot
post.description: Requires the report-snapshot approver permission. The preparer is explicitly prohibited from approval; approval creates the next immutable statement version without changing GL evidence.

get.summary: Read Property, Project, Unit, or Lot profitability from exact POSTED ledger dimensions
get.description: Returns only POSTED ledger lines carrying the exact requested property_ref, project_ref, unit_ref, or lot_ref dimension. Missing dimensions are excluded rather than inferred from a source header, memo, bank account, or display label. This operation cannot create, adjust, post, export, or persist a report.

get.summary: Read a mapping-backed statement of cash flows from POSTED ledger evidence
get.description: Each cash movement requires exactly one immutable approved or historical mapping snapshot for its cash-account and counterpart-account pair. Missing, ambiguous, invalid, or multi-cash mappings remain BLOCKED and cannot contribute to operating, investing, or financing totals. This operation cannot create, adjust, post, export, or persist a report.

get.summary: Read a mapping-backed CWIP account rollforward
get.description: Returns only POSTED ledger evidence for exact accounts admitted by one immutable CWIP account-classification mapping snapshot. It does not infer capitalization, transfers, write-offs, or zero CWIP from account labels, prefixes, source headers, or an empty result.

get.summary: Read a mapping-backed construction-loan rollforward
get.description: Returns only POSTED ledger evidence for exact accounts admitted by one immutable construction-loan account-classification mapping snapshot. Missing or ambiguous mappings remain BLOCKED. This operation cannot infer debt from account labels, create a draw or repayment, post a journal, or persist a report.

get.summary: Read a mapping-backed prepaid rollforward
get.description: Returns only POSTED ledger evidence for exact accounts admitted by one immutable prepaid account-classification mapping snapshot. Missing or ambiguous mappings remain BLOCKED. This operation cannot infer prepaid classification, create amortization, post a journal, or persist a report.

get.summary: Read a bidirectional mapped intercompany reconciliation
get.description: Requires two distinct entity scopes with exactly aligned accounting-period dates, report-view authority in both scopes, reciprocal immutable mapping snapshots, and POSTED ledger evidence. A difference is evidence for review only. This operation cannot infer a counterparty from a memo, vendor, amount, account label, or shared code, and cannot create an elimination or adjustment.

get.summary: Read approved immutable budget versus actual evidence
get.description: Returns only the latest approved immutable budget snapshot for the requested entity and period, compared with same-currency POSTED ledger evidence. The comparison side is explicit on every budget line. Missing account, currency, snapshot, or POSTED evidence remains BLOCKED and is never interpreted as zero. This operation cannot create or revise a budget, journal, mapping, or adjustment.

get.summary: Read approved immutable consolidation and elimination evidence
get.description: Reads one approved immutable consolidation scope whose members, presentation mappings, and elimination evidence are all explicit. It admits only same-currency POSTED ledger evidence from every authorized member. Missing member scope, aligned period, mapping, posted evidence, or elimination evidence remains BLOCKED. This operation cannot create an elimination, adjustment, journal, mapping, or report snapshot.

post.summary: Start one scoped bank statement reconciliation
post.description: Creates one Draft reconciliation from an authenticated entity, exact bank account, statement cutoff, opening balance, ending balance and review reason. It cannot create or post a Journal Entry.

get.summary: List admitted signed WBS statements eligible for reconciliation review
get.description: Requires both BANK.VIEW and BANK.RECONCILIATION.START. Returns only closed, signature-verified ADMITTED statement facts whose immutable receipt rows still match the account, currency, dates, and MONEY4 control total. Selection state is advisory; the start command revalidates every fact. No provider payload reference, provider statement identifier, signing key identifier, raw row, match, clearance, Journal Entry, or posting action is exposed.

get.summary: Read one admitted signed WBS statement receipt for reconciliation review
get.description: Requires both BANK.VIEW and BANK.RECONCILIATION.START. Authorization failure for either permission or the requested entity returns 403 before receipt lookup. After that scope is established, an unknown or out-of-entity receipt identifier returns a non-disclosing 404. Returns the same closed safe receipt facts as the list and cannot start or transition a reconciliation.

post.summary: Start one reconciliation from an admitted signed WBS statement receipt
post.description: Requires BANK.RECONCILIATION.START. The server derives the bank account, currency, statement dates, opening and ending balances, and exact worksheet population from one immutable signature-verified ADMITTED statement receipt. The client cannot override those facts. This starts only a Draft reconciliation; it never matches, clears, reviews, signs off, creates a Journal Entry, or posts.

post.summary: Clear or unclear one exact matched statement item
post.description: Applies optimistic concurrency to both reconciliation and bank evidence. Only an exact ACTIVE match may be cleared; signed-off evidence is immutable.

post.summary: Clear or unclear one Posted adjustment-backed statement item
post.description: Applies optimistic concurrency to one immutable Posted adjustment Draft and its exact statement bank source. It never matches a payment or creates, approves, or posts a Journal Entry; signed-off evidence is immutable.

post.summary: Review, sign off, or reopen one reconciliation
post.description: Review requires complete exact Posted payment-match or adjustment evidence and zero difference. Sign-off requires a distinct actor and writes an immutable snapshot. Reopen requires a distinct actor; no Journal Entry is created or posted.

get.summary: List exact POSTED AP-payment or AR-receipt candidates for one bank source
get.description: This is a controller-only, read-only candidate selection. Each row already has the exact entity, currency, signed amount, bank account, date-window, POSTED Journal Entry, Journal Line, Ledger Line, and no-active-match predicates required by Bank Match. It never creates a match, alters a payment, or posts a Journal Entry. Zero or multiple rows require the controller to stop; no match command is implied.

post.summary: Create one reconciliation-linked Draft Journal Entry
post.description: Creates only a balanced, attachment-backed MANUAL Draft for one exact unresolved statement bank source in an open reconciliation. The one bank-account line must resolve both that source amount and the current statement difference. It cannot submit, approve, or post the Journal Entry; normal JE workflow and a post-time reconciliation guard remain required.

get.summary: Read one open reconciliation worksheet
get.description: Returns only the authenticated entity's current DRAFT, IN_REVIEW, or REOPENED worksheet. It exposes bank evidence, the exact ACTIVE match when present, and clearance audit state; it cannot create a match, clear an item, review, sign off, reopen, or post.

get.summary: Read one immutable signed reconciliation snapshot
get.description: Returns the exact immutable snapshot captured at reconciliation sign-off in the authenticated entity. It is the historical Bank-to-Journal readback path after an operational worksheet has closed; it cannot match, clear, review, reopen, sign off, create a Draft, or post.

get.summary: Read receipt-backed WBS AutoReconciliation review evidence
get.description: Reads a bounded, authenticated company/source selection from persisted REFS evidence. It never writes WBS, matches transactions, creates a Draft, approves, posts, or changes a reconciliation state.

parameters.name: sourceRecordId
parameters.description: One to 50 immutable persisted WBS source record keys; repeat this parameter for each key.

post.summary: Persist one independent AutoRec Bank Match review decision
post.description: Requires BANK.MATCH.REVIEW. The authenticated reviewer must differ from both the exact Bank Match maker and the persisted candidate preparer. The command binds one immutable reserved candidate hash to one exact ACTIVE Bank Match revision and records only ACCEPTED or REJECTED review evidence. It never creates or posts a Journal Entry, links G11 evidence, or marks an AutoRec candidate INCURRED.

get.summary: Read one persisted AutoRec Bank Match review
get.description: Requires WBS.AUTOREC.VIEW and returns only the selected entity's immutable decision, candidate and Bank Match revisions, evidence hash, reviewer/time and SoD actors. This GET is no-store and cannot create a match, link G11 evidence, mark INCURRED, or post.

post.summary: Derive one PAYABLE_INCUR Draft from accepted AutoRec evidence
post.description: Requires BANK.AUTOREC.G11.DRAFT. Accounts, amount, member, source, mapping and lines are server-derived; callers cannot supply accounting fields. The command stops at an unsubmitted AUTO Draft.

post.summary: Derive one AUTOC Draft from accepted AutoRec evidence
post.description: Requires BANK.AUTOREC.G11.DRAFT. The dedicated producer derives the exact Bank source, approved G11 mapping, 291001 member clearing and cash leg in PostgreSQL and stops at Draft.

post.summary: Finalize two standard POSTED G11 journals as INCURRED
post.description: Requires BANK.AUTOREC.G11.INCUR and an actor independent of the candidate, match, review and both journals' maker/reviewer/approver/poster roles. PostgreSQL derives the two event and journal IDs, validates four ledger lines and exact 291001 member net zero, then appends immutable INCURRED evidence.

get.summary: Read immutable G11 event, journal, ledger and INCURRED evidence
get.description: Requires WBS.AUTOREC.VIEW. Returns no-store raw identifiers and fixed-point ledger amounts for independent readback; booleans alone are not acceptance evidence.

post.summary: Verify a signed WBS AutoRec transition contract as read-only evidence
post.description: Requires WBS AutoRec view scope and pinned signature verification. It never writes WBS, changes a REFS reconciliation state, creates a Draft, approves, or posts.

get.summary: Read immutable WBS Cost GL or Property control reconciliation evidence
get.description: Reads exact receipt-bound WBS control metrics, an approved REFS mapping, and a persisted REFS metric snapshot. It never writes WBS, creates a transaction or allocation, creates a Draft, approves, or posts.

post.summary: Import bounded WBS Payables into the staging test workflow
post.description: Staging-only authenticated bridge. Reads a sanitized unsigned live-pilot observation for the configured tenant, entity, and company; persists TEST_ONLY provenance; and uses six isolated internal actors to create, submit, review, approve, and post each Payable. It does not claim Provider signature, Object Lock, malware scan, or formal Provider admission.

post.summary: Import bounded WBS Bank observations into a controlled test reconciliation
post.description: Staging-only authenticated bridge. Requires WBS.TEST.IMPORT, the configured tenant/entity/company and one OPEN period. It retains sanitized UNSIGNED_PILOT Bank rows as CONTROLLED_TEST_UNSIGNED source evidence, creates only the fixed WBS_TEST_BANK member, and starts one ordinary DRAFT reconciliation. The Provider-signed admission route is unchanged; this operation never claims signature, formal admission, Match, Review, Sign-off, Journal or posting authority.

post.summary: Import one complete 2026 H1 WBS test month
post.description: Staging-only TEST_ONLY monthly bridge. It reads the complete H1 Payables cursor population and filters by accounting_date for the selected calendar month, reads that month's complete Bank population, rejects duplicate source hashes, cursor loops, and truncation, posts the selected Payables through AP/JE/GL, and retains Bank rows in one monthly DRAFT reconciliation. Invoke once for each January through June month with a stable monthly idempotency key. It never claims Provider signature or formal admission.

post.summary: Complete and reopen one WBS TEST_ONLY Bank reconciliation
post.description: Staging-only resumable runner for the fixed WBS_TEST_BANK scope. It uses distinct server-configured actors, prefers an exact posted payment Match when available, otherwise creates and posts a source-bound adjustment, clears every statement item, independently reviews and signs off the reconciliation, then reopens it for lifecycle proof. All output remains CONTROLLED_TEST_UNSIGNED and TEST_ONLY.

post.summary: Create one isolated WBS TEST_ONLY posted payment Bank Match
post.description: Staging-only, idempotent proof of the real Bank Match path. The server selects one deterministic unmatched legacy WBS_TEST_BANK debit and one open WBS_TEST_PAYABLE bill, creates an exact AP payment with the Bank member reference, advances its Journal Entry with distinct configured actors, posts it, and creates one ACTIVE exact payment match. Monthly H1 reconciliations and their signed snapshots are excluded from selection.
